stories.title: Police investigate fatal shooting of man, 38, following crash in West Baltimore
stories.summary: A 38-year-old man was shot and killed Saturday afternoon in West Baltimore, following a traffic collision, according to Baltimore Police.

stories.title: At Navy's stadium in Annapolis, prank turns "GO NAVY" into "GO ARMY"
stories.summary: The large letters that spell "GO NAVY" in the upper seating level of the academy's football stadium were changed to "GO ARMY" in an apparent prank.

stories.title: Passengers at BWI airport affected by Delta delays linked to a technology issue
stories.summary: A technology issue that delayed more than half of Delta Airlines flights nationwide on Sunday afternoon affected passengers at BWI.

stories.title: 15-year-old boy shot in East Baltimore, police say
stories.summary: A 15-year-old boy was shot during an incident in East Baltimore on Saturday evening.

stories.title: Ravens fall to Carolina Panthers 35 to 33 in Baltimore's sixth loss in a row
stories.summary: Bryce Young threw for 254 yards and two touchdowns and Chuba Hubbard ran for 120 yards and two more scores as the Carolina Panthers beat the Baltimore Ravens 35 to 33.

stories.title: 1 man killed, 2 people injured in crash on outer loop of I-695, police say
stories.summary: One man was killed and another two people were injured in a two-car crash on the outer loop of I-695 on Saturday evening.

stories.summary: Zachary’s Jewelers is preparing to host its annual Nutcracker celebration with the Chesapeake Ballet Company on November 29th in downtown Annapolis.
